task: Refactor a messy access-control checker into polymorphic role policies with characterisation and differential tests
reasoning_summary: Wrote a literal characterisation table and kept the legacy implementation as an oracle in the test tree, then extracted Role (per-role policy via enum constant bodies), Action, Resource and Decision. An exhaustive 10x7x6x3x3x2x6 grid differential test exposed a legacy quirk (null action rejected before role-name validation) that the hand-written table missed; the first run failed and the refactor was corrected to preserve it.
